title: WWC child safety training: national training doesn't count, and a 30-day window to apply
body: The Social Services Regulator's FAQs for mandatory Working with Children child safety training starting on 19 October 2026 confirm that completing national child safety training does not exempt anyone from the Victorian training. Once someone finishes the training they have 30 days to submit their application, or they must do it again. The training will be made available online in coming weeks to current clearance holders who are not yet due to renew.
verifiedQuote: If you have completed national child safety training, you are still required complete the Victorian child safety training... Once you complete the child safety training, you have 30 days to submit your WWC Check application.
correction: The source confirms national training doesn't exempt from Victorian training and the 30-day window, but incorrectly states the training 'will be' available in coming weeks rather than 'is' available, and the FAQs are ongoing updates not a single update event.
